morgan: Heads up - hitting a weird failure with ExternalSecrets + Vault rolebinding after a helm overlay for the payments svc. rotation not triggering, secrets stay stale.

sanam: What error are you seeing in the controller logs?

morgan: Logs show 401 from Vault and 'kubernetes auth: bound service account mismatch' when controller attempts refresh. snippet below.

morgan: ```
time=\"2026-03-15T18:02:10Z\" level=error msg=\"vault auth failed\" err=\"permission denied (401)\"\ncontroller=externalsecret/name=payments-secrets
```

kevin: Quick check — did the helm overlay change the ServiceAccount name for the workload? Vault roles bind to SA name + namespace.

morgan: Yes — the overlay sets serviceAccount.name: payments-svc, but our Vault role only lists payment-service-sa. I think that's the mismatch.

irene: Right — two common fixes: update helm values to keep the original SA name, or add the new SA to the Vault role bound_service_account_names. Also note controller version matters: older ExternalSecrets controllers use controller SA for auth.

sanam: Which ES controller version are we running in cluster?

morgan: 0.6.0

irene: 0.6.x does not support per-secret projected SA for Vault auth. The controller uses the controller ServiceAccount unless you upgraded and use token projection features. So either make Vault role accept the controller SA or change the overlay.

kevin: Short-term pragmatic change: add the new SA to the Vault role. We can follow up with an upgrade to 0.8+ and a better model. Proposed terraform change below.

sanam: Proposed TF snippet (works with our vault provider):

morgan: ```hcl
resource \"vault_kubernetes_auth_backend_role\" \"payments\" {\n  backend     = \"kubernetes\"\n  role_name   = \"payments-role\"\n  bound_service_account_names = [\"payment-service-sa\", \"payments-svc\"]\n  bound_service_account_namespaces = [\"default\"]\n  token_policies = [\"payments-secrets-read\"]\n}\n```

kevin: That looks good. Add a short comment explaining why we allow two SA names (helm overlay backward compatibility). Also include a tfstate import note if needed.

morgan: I'll open a small PR with the TF change plus a quick k8s job that tries to read the secret post-apply. PR will include a smoketest manifest.

irene: Also add a Prometheus alert: externalsecrets_refresh_failures > 5 for 10m in staging so we can catch regressions. And add an infra runbook note under secrets/role-bindings.md.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for infra/terraform#432 

morgan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/432 — includes terraform change + k8s smoke job that curls the payment service to ensure creds rotated.

sanam: LGTM, please apply to staging first and I'll watch the ExternalSecrets controller logs. :thumbsup:

morgan: Will apply later this afternoon, will post status once done. Thanks!
